answer: One agent pays 130 POA and 18 minutes once; a farm of 400 pays 52000 POA and 7200 minutes, every epoch. The bench where honest agents are made is Accredited candle maker wax dipping record with master craftsman endorsement, and the bench work reads 7-year apprenticeship, 46 supervised candle batches, practical trial, guild dues. An honest hand passes once; a farm pays a hundred benches and still fails. Put the canyon beside the vertex and the relic beside both: the pile on the bench is the proof, and the pile is heavy.
